title: Method Section Output
description: Structured output schema for the method section content extraction. Typed unit arrays: methods. Valid unit types: Method.

anchor_id.description: ID of the unit that anchors this section; it must be defined in one typed unit array

methods.description: Method units extracted for this section

id.description: Unit identifier in lowercase prefix:descriptor format

provenance.description: Location markers for this unit: top-level section anchors such as ['\u00a71', '\u00a72']

role.description: Argumentative role: contribution (the single primary method/system), component (a sub-method that is part_of the contribution), builds_on (prior work extended), or compared_against (a baseline)

method_kind.description: Optional structural classification of the method; omit when unclear

description.description: Prose description of the method; empty string when unknown

inputs.description: Inputs to the method; omit when the paper does not state them

outputs.description: Outputs of the method; omit when the paper does not state them

name.description: Short label for the equation, e.g. 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention'; empty string when unnamed

expression.description: The equation itself, as LaTeX or plain text, e.g. 'softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d_k))V'

symbols.description: Definitions of the symbols and variables appearing in the expression; empty array when the expression introduces none

symbol.description: A symbol or variable from the expression, e.g. 'Q', 'd_k', 'W^O'

description.description: What the symbol denotes, e.g. 'query matrix', 'dimension of the keys'

formulas.description: Key defining equations of the method, each with a short label; omit when the method states none

expression.description: The objective or loss as LaTeX or plain text, e.g. 'L = -sum log P(y|x)'

description.description: What the objective optimizes; empty string when only the formula is reported

symbols.description: Definitions of the symbols and variables appearing in the expression; empty array when the expression introduces none

symbol.description: A symbol or variable from the expression, e.g. 'Q', 'd_k', 'W^O'

description.description: What the symbol denotes, e.g. 'query matrix', 'dimension of the keys'

objective_function.description: The optimization objective or loss the method minimizes/maximizes; omit when the method defines none

implementation_notes.description: Key implementation details; empty string when none are reported
